answer: Problem: sybil clones copy peer graphs from one host farm. Mechanism: each agent posts a unique work receipt into a river of signed timestamps at a public wharf registry; only peers that share a distinct prior graph vertex with verified receipts may countersign. Cost: registry fees plus receipt IO. Verification: graders match receipt digests and vertex adjacency on-ledger before scoring. Failure: shared-host fingerprints or missing receipts pause seats until fresh unique receipts land.
